selection.reason: The rear combination lamp's annotated rear-position and stop functions, and any confirmed reversing function, require the applicable light-signalling performance, colour, construction and marking requirements under this consolidated regulation.
The separate passive retro-reflective insert must meet the applicable retro-reflector requirements under this regulation, which consolidates UN R3.

For either the suggested M1 or N1 application, installation of the rear lamps and retro-reflector must satisfy applicable positioning, orientation, geometric visibility and electrical-connection requirements.
The LED PCB and associated electronics bring the lamp assembly within the electromagnetic-compatibility assessment applicable to vehicle electrical/electronic subassemblies.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the suggested M1 application is confirmed, the accessible exterior lens and housing must satisfy applicable external-projection, edge and curvature requirements.

verworfen (Annahme, nicht in der Spec): If the suggested M1 application is confirmed, the requirement for lighting and signalling devices to remain operational and visible after prescribed low-speed impacts makes the rear lamp's robustness and mounting relevant.
Rear-position and stop lamps are relevant functions, but UN R148 consolidates UN R7 and is selected instead.
A reversing function is annotated but not optically confirmed; if present, its component requirements are covered by the selected consolidated UN R148 rather than UN R23.
The separate retro-reflector is relevant, but UN R150 consolidates UN R3 and is selected instead.
Discrete LEDs mounted on a PCB do not establish use of an Annex 1 standardised LED light-source category; UN R128 would apply only if such a source were specified.
The outer lens is glazing for a lighting or light-signalling device, which is expressly excluded from this regulation's scope.

drawing.product: Exploded view of an elongated rear combination lamp incorporating an LED light source, reflector optics and a separate retro-reflector.
drawing.vehicle_location: Rear exterior of the vehicle, likely near a rear corner. The drawing does not establish left- or right-hand installation.

parts.name: Outer lens
parts.function: Covers and protects the internal optical components while transmitting lamp light.
parts.technology: Light-transmitting lens, likely molded plastic; identified as red in the drawing.
parts.evidence: The foremost component is a broad, tapered cover with a perimeter lip and a small outlined rectangular region.

parts.name: Retro-reflector
parts.function: Returns externally incident light toward its source for passive visibility.
parts.technology: Separate patterned retro-reflective insert; exact prism geometry and material are not shown.
parts.evidence: A small rectangular plate with parallel internal lines is shown behind the outer lens and explicitly labeled.

parts.name: Seal / gasket
parts.function: Seals the lens-to-housing interface against water and contamination.
parts.technology: Continuous perimeter gasket, likely an elastomer.
parts.evidence: A thin, open-centered frame follows the outer lens profile between the cover and internal assembly.

parts.name: Reflector / internal optical carrier
parts.function: Directs and distributes light from the LED board into distinct illuminated regions.
parts.technology: Formed optical carrier with an array of reflector cells and additional partitioned optical areas; material and reflective finish are unspecified.
parts.evidence: The central insert contains rows of oval recesses, an upper row of circular features, a central rectangular region and a smaller gridded end region.

parts.name: LED modules on PCB
parts.function: Generate light for the lamp functions.
parts.technology: Multiple discrete LED packages on a printed circuit board, with additional electronic component footprints.
parts.evidence: A separate elongated board carries repeated square devices arranged in rows, along with smaller rectangular components and a larger outlined end feature.

parts.name: Housing
parts.function: Supports and encloses the optical and electronic parts and provides attachment interfaces.
parts.evidence: The rearmost large component is a tray-like shell with a raised perimeter rim, visible depth and several circular attachment features.

parts.name: Fasteners / clips
parts.function: Secure the assembly and maintain its position.
parts.technology: Three illustrated screw-like fasteners; their material is not specified.
parts.evidence: Separate slender shanks with rounded, slotted-looking heads are positioned along dashed assembly lines near the housing.

uncertainties: Dimensions, mounting height, vehicle attachment details and installation side are not provided.

The annotated performance statements are not demonstrated by the exploded drawing.
